code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), mild leukopenia with neutropenia, monocytosis, and basophilia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated creatinine (possible renal impairment), low total protein, and elevated inflammatory markers (CRP, ferritin, INR). These findings suggest acute respiratory failure with systemic inflammation, possible infection/sepsis, and multi-organ involvement. Immediate clinical evaluation and intervention are recommended.
